name: qelcare-patient-mobile
description: Patient-only QELCare mobile app packaged with Capacitor for Android APK builds; regenerated against qelcaresql-V7 full dump.

scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
